name: VO2 Max
description: Estimates VO2 max from heart rate and pace during a steady outdoor run. Enter your max HR (and lab VO2 max results, if you have them) in the UNA app. Early version: thresholds are not yet tuned on real watch data, so treat results as indicative. Feedback welcome.

configFields.label: Max heart rate
configFields.description: Needed for the VO2 max estimate; use the value from a lab test if you have one. Leave at 0 if unknown.

configFields.label: Lab VO2 max
configFields.description: VO2 max from a lab test in ml/kg/min, if you have one. Each new value and date is added to the lab results in the app. Leave at 0 if none.

configFields.label: Lab test date
configFields.description: Date of the lab test above, as YYYY-MM-DD.
configFields.validationMessage: A date as YYYY-MM-DD, or empty.
